purpose: Six alternative concept sketches for discussion; no design selected or implemented.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape game prop design sketch sheet for Trackstorm, a gritty stylized demolition vehicle combat game. Input image is a STYLE AND VEHICLE REFERENCE ONLY: use the red armored off-road Car, exposed roll cage, battered metal panels, chunky tires and utilitarian hardware as the visual world. Completely discard the rounded gray tombstone shield in that reference; do NOT reproduce it, no gravestone or arch motif.
Medium: expressive professional industrial-design pencil/ink sketch with restrained opaque color washes, visible construction strokes, off-white paper, readable silhouette, moderate detail, NOT a photoreal render and NOT a screenshot.
Layout: title at top, left third a rear three-quarter view of the reference-like red car carrying a compact rear shield, right two thirds a much larger isolated three-quarter view of the SAME shield released and expanded into a freestanding wide protective wall, small hinge/motion arrows only. Small labels "MOUNTED" and "DEPLOYED". The mechanism and materials must visibly correspond between both states. Compact shield is roughly car width, the deployed wall roughly twice as wide and taller, plausible folded side panels and metal support frame. Clear separation and generous margins, no front-mounted shield, no weapon barrels, no characters, no fantasy magic, no glowing energy, no brand logos. This is visual ideation, not a dimensioned or certified engineering drawing. Make the theme distinctive in silhouette, construction, palette and deployment, not just decoration.

Text (verbatim title): "01 / DOZER".
Specific theme: Earthmoving and construction equipment. A curved concave bulldozer blade of chipped ochre yellow steel, shallow V plan, heavy dark scraping lip, blunt angular shoulders, vertical reinforcing ribs and a couple of black warning stripes. Folded side blades nest inward behind the center, then swing outward into a broad tough wall. Thick gussets, pivot pins, rear hydraulic braces, purposeful battered excavator equipment. Bold wide low silhouette. No spikes, no decorative crest.

Text (verbatim title): "02 / ARMADILLO".
Specific theme: Purpose-built military survival armor, subdued olive green and charcoal with small bone-white serial marks. An angular layered shell composed of overlapping trapezoidal armored scales. Compact state has a faceted central back plate with the side scales nested tightly behind it. Deployed state fans out into a shallow zigzag armored wall using obvious short articulated hinge linkages. Chamfered edges, squat dense proportions, matte armored panels, exposed dark skeleton. No arch, no rounded plow blade, no yellow construction paint.

Text (verbatim title): "03 / JUNKYARD".
Specific theme: Improvised demolition derby scrapyard wall. Salvaged car doors and hoods, red faded turquoise and bare steel, irregular welded patchwork, thick square-tube skeleton, visible weld beads, large repair plates. Strong asymmetrical stepped silhouette with a battered central automotive panel and different-sized folding side panels. Deployed wall looks hand-built from salvage but structurally legible and solidly protective, no wide gaps. Compact back of car convincingly resembles a bundle of salvaged armor. No symmetrical military plates, no plow blade, no arch.

Text (verbatim title): "04 / PIT WALL".
Specific theme: Motorsport crash-barrier theme. A compact steel carrier holding tightly packed worn racing tires and heavy rubber impact blocks, red tube framing, off-white scratched number plate, white/red track curbing details. Deployed wall is a stout wide row of stacked tires on solid interlocking metal backing panels; fold-out wings retain the same tire groups as compact shield. Big readable black rubber circular forms, chunky exposed hinges and retaining straps, a little sidewall chalk. NOT a tire launcher; no projectiles; protective barrier. No plow, no armor crest.

Text (verbatim title): "05 / FREIGHT".
Specific theme: Industrial freight/container shutter theme. Strong corrugated steel surfaces in weathered shipping-container teal with rust-red and bare-metal edges. A narrow folded accordion pack of thick vertically ribbed panels carried behind the car; unfolds sideways like a heavy industrial security gate into a solid broad shield wall. Bold rectilinear stepped top, substantial hinge knuckles, diagonal braces, chunky locking feet, tiny loading stencils. Corrugations should dominate the design and be visible in both states. No plow blade, no gravestone arch, no piles of tires.

Text (verbatim title): "06 / IRONCLAD".
Specific theme: Junkyard knight / medieval shield interpreted entirely through modern demolition-car steel fabrication. A bold angular kite-shaped central armor plate with clipped pointed upper shoulders and an angular lower edge, simple welded chevron reinforcing ridge, oxidized dark iron and faded burgundy paint, large square bolts. Two folding angular pavise-like side armor leaves turn the compact heraldic-looking rear shield into a broad ground-standing defensive wall. Segmented lower skirts make the deployed base stable. Mechanically fabricated with visible car-suspension-style hinges and braces, not fantasy equipment. No crest artwork, skulls, lettering emblems, glow, gravestone arches or plow blades.
